title: Fix keys.ts @ai-summary comment style inconsistency
body: src/infra/loading/keys.ts:1 opens with `// @ai-summary` (line comment) instead of the `/** @ai-summary */` JSDoc block used by all sibling files. Cosmetic — the annotation is still present inside a proper JSDoc at line 6, so functionality is unaffected.
rationale: Consistency with sibling files; low priority.
